source: Client report sample (Global Medical Films Market, CMI): research definition, scope and company-profile clusters; owner's choices 2026-10-12 (150 companies, 20 browsers, companies named in the sample seeded and checked like every other company); owner chose the PDF's player set: medical-grade polymer / material suppliers; scope widened 2026-10-12 (diversified makers are core); 2026-10-12: polymer suppliers ONLY, adjacent segments excluded (owner)
market_definition: This landscape covers the suppliers of the medical-grade POLYMER MATERIALS that medical films are made from: thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) and other polyurethanes, polyethylene, polypropylene, polyester / PET, ethylene vinyl acetate, silicone-based polymers, polyamide and other medical-grade film resins, compounds and elastomers, sold to medical film converters, adhesive and lamination makers and device makers for wound dressing, catheter securement, surgical drape, NPWT, wearable sensor and medical packaging films.
core_scope: A core player itself produces medical-grade polymer materials (resins, compounds, TPU / TPE / silicone / polyurethane grades, film-grade polymers) and sells them under its own name -- including large chemical groups for which these are one business line. It must make the MATERIAL, not the film.
adjacent_segments: Film extruders, converters, laminators and coaters (they buy the polymers)
Medical packaging, tape, label and adhesive-product makers
Wound-care, catheter, drape, NPWT and wearable-device makers
Distributors and traders of other companies' polymers
Commodity polymer producers with no medical-grade grade
scope: ONLY producers of medical-grade POLYMER MATERIALS (resins, compounds, TPU, TPE, polyurethane, silicone, PE, PP, PET, EVA, polyamide grades) that medical film makers buy. A company qualifies only if it makes the polymer material itself; a large chemical group with a medical-grade polymer line qualifies. NOT in this market: any company that makes films, sheets, tapes, labels, laminates, coated products, packaging or finished medical products from purchased polymers (film extruders, converters, laminators, coaters, packaging makers, wound-care and device makers), and distributors and traders.
